title: Fans Choose Troye Sivan’s ‘She’s the Best’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
summary: His fourth full-length album brought in 56% of the vote.
contentText:
She’s the Best , the new studio album from Troye Sivan , tops this week’s new music poll.

Listeners voted in a poll published Friday (Oct. 9)  on  Billboard , choosing Sivan’s latest full-length LP as their favorite new music.

The album rose above new releases from Cardi B, Slayyyter, Ez Mil with Eminem, Pitbull, Remi Wolf and more on the poll, landing 56% of the vote by closing time on Sunday.

“As long as there’s cultural conversation and people kind of listening to the songs and understanding what I’m trying to say, and watching the videos, that’s kind of my thing that I care about,” Sivan told Billboard during a recent interview on the release of his new album, which arrived Friday.

Of the set’s title track, “She’s the Best” — an advance single that boasts Nicole Kidman as the star of its music video — Sivan said, “It’s such an important song to me. It’s just something I hadn’t explored before in music. It’s something I’ve felt for my whole life and never really had a way to express it.”

“The album is such a journey,” he shared. “There’s sort of whiplash between these songs that I feel like I’m performing on stage — they’re super big, and bombastic — and then all of a sudden I’m like depressed and lonely in my hotel room, writing songs about this man I have not met yet, these manifestation love songs, there’s almost like this pathetic element to the album as well. I think I spent so much time in both of those places and neither felt like they were really totally fulfilling me.”

He continued, “When I arrived at ‘She’s the Best,’ I think that’s also why I made it the album title — I realized that was the one thing that is constant in my life, and that has always been constant, and the stability of it and the support I’ve had from the women and feminine people in my life has been the thing that’s got me through all areas.”

Coming up behind She’s the Best on the poll are Cardi B’s “Don’t Chart,” with 9% of the vote, and Slayyyter’s “I Think He’s Got a Girl,” with 7% of the vote.
